images.tema: Torres de alta tensión sobre un trigal de Castilla al atardecer
images.subject: Lattice steel high-voltage transmission towers marching in a line across golden wheat fields on the Castilian plain in Spain at golden hour, power lines glowing in the low sun, low-angle shot with a wide lens, long soft shadows, a few thin clouds in a clear sky.

images.tema: Subestación eléctrica a la hora azul, con un técnico de espaldas
images.subject: An electrical substation in Spain at blue hour: large power transformers, porcelain insulators, busbars and galvanised steel gantries in sharp detail, one technician in a high-visibility vest and white hard hat seen from behind walking between the equipment, small in the frame, warm lights beginning to glow against a deep blue sky.

images.tema: Planta fotovoltaica en Andalucía vista desde un dron
images.subject: Aerial top-down drone photograph of a vast photovoltaic solar farm in Andalusia, Spain: long parallel rows of dark blue solar panels forming bold graphic lines over warm reddish earth, a gravel service track cutting diagonally across, olive groves at the edges, bright midday light with crisp shadows.

images.tema: Parque eólico en Aragón al amanecer, con niebla en el valle
images.subject: Modern white wind turbines along a ridge in Aragon, Spain at dawn, morning mist filling the valley below, soft pastel sunrise light, telephoto lens compressing the line of turbines, blades slightly motion-blurred, quiet and expansive atmosphere.

images.tema: Estación de regulación y medida de gas, tuberías amarillas
images.subject: A natural gas pressure regulating and metering station in Spain: yellow-painted steel gas pipes, large valves, flanges and pressure gauges inside a tidy fenced industrial compound, eye-level medium shot, clean concrete ground, soft overcast daylight, precise engineering detail.
